purpose: Local (offline) execution evidence for the W01 Payload migration against a miniflare-proxied local D1. This is NOT remote D1 evidence; remote schema inspection remains blocked on Cloudflare credentials.
migrationCommand: PAYLOAD_SECRET=ignore pnpm exec payload migrate (dev mode, no NODE_ENV=production -> getPlatformProxy without remoteBindings -> local miniflare D1, persist default)

users_columns: updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT strftime
created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT strftime

driftCheck.note: Every column/index/FK in the local D1 schema corresponds 1:1 to statements in workers/W01-payload/src/migrations/20250929_111647.ts

limits: LOCAL_MINIFLARE_D1 only; remote D1 (luckread) not inspected (credentials missing)

auth_session_state extension table (AUTH-002 contract session-state entity) is ABSENT by design; W01 uses Payload native users_sessions. Absence is accepted by scripts/auth-session-schema-evidence-validate.mjs.
Does not promote AUTH-002 or Mapping-0; runtime session behavior evidence remains a separate gate (Batch 07)
captureCommands: sqlite3 <local-d1.sqlite> 'SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type IN ("table","index","trigger") ORDER BY type,name;' > catalog.txt
